headline: On this Sunday, 13 September 2026
detail: Apps Court Farm's car boot page carries the banner "THE CAR BOOT IS OPEN THIS SUNDAY". We read that on the evening of Friday 11 September, so it refers to the coming Sunday, 13 September. There is no postponement or cancellation notice anywhere on the page. The farm posts its dates at the top of that page weekly and says any weather postponement will be posted in the same place, so a notice can still appear at short notice between now and Sunday morning. Gates open at 7am and the sale closes at 1pm. Check the banner on the official page or call 01932 244 822 for the recorded status before travelling.
